title: Runtime sync canvas & action log - midweek prep
agenda: Incident debrief: driver-ks-112 (10m) - root cause hypothesis + short-term mitigation
Canary rollout: console v0.9 -> v0.10 gating metrics (10m)
Autoscaler knobs: burst policy tweak proposal (5m)
prep_questions: Can we get 1 line on current OOM hotspots from infra? (Kyla)
Is LTP (long tail percentile) coming from specific model families or batch sizes? (Priya)
Any objections to lowering burst threshold from 85% -> 75% for 2hr window? (M)
Need a short blurb for CS about the console canary fallback behavior (Asha)
Who will run the post-canary smoke check on Thursday morning?
notes:
Scratchpad: rough ordering of topics above. Keep the 'canary' discussion tight — we only need approval on gating metrics (error rate, p99 latency, request timeout). Bring the small chart snapshots (p95/p99 last 72h) to show trend.

Incident driver-ks-112: started 11/16 02:12 PT, brief spike in kv-cache miss due to a bad patch to cache eviction. Patch reverted; still seeing sporadic miss spikes at 03:40-04:10. Hypothesis: async evict path races when load shifts. Checklist for debrief: timeline + logs (k8s pod restarts), GRPC error codes, affected customer buckets.

Console canary: rolling to 10% region traffic for 2 hours. Need to ensure fallback to v0.9 works at the routing layer; test plan: simulate 5000 small requests/min across 3 model types, watch for 5xx and latency increase.

Misc notes: remind SRE to annotate any manual scale-ups in the incident channel. Put a lightweight telemetry tag on the canary rollout so billing/latency correlates.

Tone: keep things quick, we want decisions and owners, not design deep dives. If someone asks for design time, schedule a follow-up deep dive slot next week.

Links referenced inline: CON-823 (canary play), RFC-serve-eager-kv (draft), PR github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987 (evict-fix).
quick_rundown: Goal: unblock canary and close the driver-ks-112 follow-ups. Accept small, explicit mitigations today; schedule larger refactor after signoff.
